description.zh: AI自动解析卷宗要素，智能比对证据链并预警逻辑漏洞，辅助办案审查。
description.en: AI parses dossier elements, cross-checks the evidence chain and flags logic gaps to aid case review.

welcome_message.zh: 上传卷宗材料，我来解析要素、比对证据链并提示漏洞
welcome_message.en: Upload dossier materials — I'll parse elements, check the evidence chain and flag gaps

description.zh: 输入：卷宗文书与证据材料（可用内置 pdf/docx 技能解析）。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 review.md（审查意见）与 evidence-chain.md（证据链比对表）
description.en: Input: dossier documents and evidence (parsed via built-in pdf/docx skills). Output: review.md and evidence-chain.md under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请审查以下卷宗材料。

卷宗文书与证据清单（粘贴内容或说明文件名）：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 review.md（卷宗要素解析、证据链完整性比对、逻辑漏洞与补证建议）和 evidence-chain.md（证据-待证事实-印证关系对照表）。审查结论标注"仅供办案审查参考"，示例证据标注为演示数据。
prompt.en:
Please review the following dossier.

Dossier documents and evidence list (paste content or file names):

Expected output: review.md (element parsing, evidence-chain completeness, logic gaps and supplementation advice) and evidence-chain.md (evidence-fact-corroboration table) under outbound/<task>/. Mark conclusions "for case review reference only"; label sample evidence as demo data.
